## Checklist

- [ ] Commit subjects read `<emoji> <TITLE> - <description>`, in English
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run test:integration` pass
- [ ] Every user-facing string is a catalog key, not a literal
- [ ] Docs updated, `README.md` / `docs/*.md` together with their `.it.md` twins
- [ ] Visual baselines agreed in their own commit, after looking at each frame (dashboard changes only)
